method: Exploratory post-hoc inventory of explicit read_code/read_files calls from complete immutable ledgers. Bytes serialize the recorded output JSON compactly in UTF-8; batching, formatting and recorder redaction differ between tools. These are not forwarded request bytes, billed tokens, cache misses, semantic relevance, total information exposure or a causal explanation of arm resource differences. Shell reads/search/edit/validation outputs are deliberately outside this narrow inventory; do not treat missing read calls as no reading. All primary acceptance/resource criteria remain unchanged.
